```{r, echo = FALSE}
)
```

## Read in metadata file and match to raw data
```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}

#read in metadatfile
md <- (here::here("Processed_Data", "COMPASS_TEMPESTX_SoilFluxes_8100_Metadata_processed_20260604.csv"))
metadat <- read.csv(md) 

#make some changes to the start times
metadat_edited <- metadat

#Control metadata 
ctrl_metadat <- metadat_edited %>%
  filter(Plot == "Control")

#freshwater metadata 
fresh_metadat <- metadat_edited %>%
  filter(Plot == "Fresh") 

#saltwater metadata 
salt_metadat <- metadat_edited %>%
  filter(Plot == "Salt") 

```


######## Control MATCHING ##############

## Match Control metadata to raw data
```{r, echo = FALSE}

#match the metadata to the concentration data 
alldat_ctrl$metadat_row <- ffi_metadata_match(
  data_timestamps = alldat_ctrl$TIMESTAMP,
  start_dates = ctrl_metadat$Date,
  start_times = ctrl_metadat$Time,
  obs_lengths = ctrl_metadat$total_seconds) 
# head(alldat)

#Set plot, temp, volume, etc. here 
alldat_ctrl$Plot <- ctrl_metadat$unique_ID[alldat_ctrl$metadat_row]
alldat_ctrl$Volume <- ctrl_metadat$Vtotal_m3[alldat_ctrl$metadat_row]
alldat_ctrl$final_temp <- ctrl_metadat$Tcham[alldat_ctrl$metadat_row] #from 8100 file
alldat_ctrl$V2_avg <- ctrl_metadat$V2_avg[alldat_ctrl$metadat_row] 
alldat_ctrl$V3_avg <- ctrl_metadat$V3_avg[alldat_ctrl$metadat_row] 
alldat_ctrl$V4_avg <- ctrl_metadat$V4_avg[alldat_ctrl$metadat_row] 
alldat_ctrl$flag <- ctrl_metadat$flag[alldat_ctrl$metadat_row] 

ctrl_metadat$metadat_row <- seq_len(nrow(ctrl_metadat))


### Need to deal with weird temperatures - probably take the one from the closest reasonable measurement 

#remove the rows that don't match to metadata
alldat_ctrl <- alldat_ctrl %>%
filter(!is.na(metadat_row))

#can remove any row that have NA's in the CO2 column
alldat_ctrl <- alldat_ctrl %>%
filter(!is.na(N2O))

```

## Match Salt metadata to raw data
```{r, echo = FALSE}

salt_alldat <- alldat_salt

#match the metadata to the concentration data

  data_timestamps = salt_alldat$TIMESTAMP,
  start_dates = salt_metadat$Date,
  start_times = salt_metadat$Time,
  obs_lengths = salt_metadat$total_seconds) 
# head(alldat)

#Set plot, temp, volume, etc. here 
salt_alldat$Plot <- salt_metadat$unique_ID[salt_alldat$metadat_row]
salt_alldat$Volume <- salt_metadat$Vtotal_m3[salt_alldat$metadat_row]
salt_alldat$final_temp <- salt_metadat$Tcham[salt_alldat$metadat_row] #from 8100 file
salt_alldat$V2_avg <- salt_metadat$V2_avg[salt_alldat$metadat_row] 
salt_alldat$V3_avg <- salt_metadat$V3_avg[salt_alldat$metadat_row] 
salt_alldat$V4_avg <- salt_metadat$V4_avg[salt_alldat$metadat_row] 
salt_alldat$flag <- salt_metadat$flag[salt_alldat$metadat_row]
```

## Combine all the matched data back into one dataframe 
```{r}

alldat <-  bind_rows(alldat_ctrl, salt_alldat) #, fresh_alldat

```

## Calculate fluxes 
```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#change the units
alldat$N2O_nmol <- ffi_ppb_to_nmol(alldat$N2O, 
                                   volume = alldat$Volume # m3
                                   )    # degrees C
#> Assuming atm = 101325 Pa
#> Using R = 8.31446261815324 m3 Pa K-1 mol-1

alldat$N2O_nmol_m2 <- alldat$N2O_nmol / 0.16

fluxes <- ffi_compute_fluxes(alldat,
                             group_column = "Plot", 
                             time_column = "TIMESTAMP", 
                             gas_column = "N2O_nmol_m2", 
                             dead_band = 10) #, c0_band = 5?
# head(fluxes)

#take a look at the fluxes we calculated with R2 
ggplot(fluxes, aes(Plot, lin_flux.estimate, color = lin_r.squared)) +
  geom_point(size=4) + theme_classic() + 
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lin_flux.estimate- lin_flux.std.error,
                   ymax = lin_flux.estimate+ lin_flux.std.error)) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colours = c("darkred",  "red", "white","lightblue", "darkblue"),
                        values = c(0, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 1)) +
  ylab("N2O flux (nmol/m2/s)")+ 
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) 

#sort fluxes by R2 
fluxes_good <- as.data.frame(subset(fluxes, lin_r.squared >= .90, select = Plot:TIMESTAMP_max))
fluxes_weird <- as.data.frame(subset(fluxes, lin_r.squared < .90, select = Plot:TIMESTAMP_max))

#negative N2O fluxes
fluxes_negative <- as.data.frame(subset(fluxes,  lin_flux.estimate < 0, select = Plot:TIMESTAMP_max))

#find fluxes that represent the first and fourth quartile of the data 
low <- quantile(fluxes$lin_flux.estimate, 0.05) 
high <- quantile(fluxes$lin_flux.estimate, 0.95) 

fluxes_low <- as.data.frame(subset(fluxes, lin_flux.estimate <= low, select = Plot:TIMESTAMP_max))
fluxes_high <- as.data.frame(subset(fluxes, lin_flux.estimate >= high, select = Plot:TIMESTAMP_max))

tails <- rbind(fluxes_low, fluxes_high)


```

## Check the fluxes for which I changed the start time due to lags or ebullition (recorded in notes of metadata)
```{r, echo=FALSE}

tobechecked <- c()

colnames <- c("Plot")

#Empty list to store plots
plot_list <- list()

#Loop to run plots above 
for(P in tobechecked){ 
  r1 <- subset(alldat, Plot == P)
  p1 <- ggplot(r1, aes(TIMESTAMP, N2O)) + geom_point() + theme_classic() +
  ylab(expression(paste( N[2], "O (ppb)"))) +
  xlab("Time") + labs(title = P) + 
  geom_smooth(color="red")
  
  plot_list[[length(plot_list) + 1]] <- p1
}
```

## Spot check a few fluxes with R2 > 0.9
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

### pull a random sample of good fluxes to check and plot 
good_plots <- unique(fluxes_good$Plot)

# take a random sample (FALSE so we don't get the same plot twice)
# set.seed(...) to guarantee reproducibility
good_sample <- sample(good_plots, 5, replace=FALSE)

#Empty list to store plots
plot_list <- list()

#Loop to run five random plots subset above 
for(P in good_sample){ 
  r1 <- subset(alldat, Plot == P)
  
  p1 <- ggplot(r1, aes(TIMESTAMP, N2O)) + geom_point() + theme_classic() +
  ylab(expression(paste( N[2], "O (ppb)"))) +
  xlab("Time") + labs(title = P) + 
  geom_smooth(color="red")
  
  plot_list[[length(plot_list) + 1]] <- p1
}

### number of plots per page
plots_per_page <- 2

# split plots into pages
plot_pages <- split(
  plot_list,
  ceiling(seq_along(plot_list) / plots_per_page)
)

# print each page
for(i in seq_along(plot_pages)) {
  
  print(
    wrap_plots(plot_pages[[i]], ncol = 2)
  )
  
}

####################
```

## Do some visualization of QAQC plots to assess fluxes  
```{r, echo=FALSE}

p1 <- ggplot(fluxes, aes(lin_flux.estimate, rob_flux.estimate, color = Plot)) +
  geom_point(size=4) + geom_abline() + 
  theme_classic() + 
  labs(title = "A") + 
  ylab(expression(paste( N[2], "O Flux (nmol m"^-2* " s"^-1*") Robust Method"))) +
  xlab(expression(paste( N[2], "O Flux (nmol m"^-2* " s"^-1*") Linear Method"))) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Plot")) +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size=12), axis.text = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=12), legend.text=element_text(size=12),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth =1), 
        aspect.ratio = 1)
p1


p2 <- ggplot(fluxes, aes(lin_r.squared, poly_r.squared, color = Plot)) +
  geom_point(size=4) + geom_abline() + 
  theme_classic() + 
  xlim(0,1) + ylim(0,1) +
  labs(title = "B") + 
  ylab(expression(paste("R"^2* " Second-Order Polynomial"))) +
  xlab(expression(paste("R"^2* " Linear Model"))) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Plot")) + 
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size=12), axis.text = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=12), legend.text=element_text(size=12),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth =1), 
        aspect.ratio = 1)
p2

p3 <- ggplot(fluxes, aes(lin_flux.estimate, HM81_flux.estimate, color = lin_r.squared )) +
  geom_point(size=4) + geom_abline() + 
  theme_classic() + 
  #xlim(0,50) + #ylim(0,50) +
  labs(title = "C") + 
  ylab(expression(paste( N[2], "O Flux (nmol m"^-2* " s"^-1*") HM1981 Method"))) +
  xlab(expression(paste( N[2], "O Flux (nmol m"^-2* " s"^-1*") Linear Method"))) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Plot")) + 
  theme(legend.position="right") +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size=12), axis.text = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=12), legend.text=element_text(size=12),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth =1), 
        aspect.ratio = 1)
```

## Pull together dataframe and export for use elsewhere 
```{r, echo=FALSE}

####Already flagged poor fluxes, negative fluxes, and low r squared fluxes that are actually okay

#make new columns with the plot; zone; replicate 
IDs <- data.frame(do.call('rbind', strsplit(as.character(fluxes$Plot),'_',fixed=TRUE)))
colnames(IDs) <- c("NA",  "label", "StartTime")
# head(IDs)

#rejoin them to the dataframe
allflux <- cbind(IDs, fluxes)

##Add in notes from metadata - add this in when we fix the fluxes
metadat_notes <- metadat_edited[, c("unique_ID", "flag")]
allflux_notes <- allflux %>%
  left_join(metadat_notes, by=c("Plot"="unique_ID"))

allflux_notes$`NA`<- NULL
allflux_notes$`NA`<- NULL

#Change file name
write.csv(allflux_notes, file=here::here("Processed_Data", "COMPASS_TEMPESTX_SoilFluxes_7820_N2O_processed_20260604.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
